args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
`src/money.py`'s docstring says `round_money` uses banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the code was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Because of that, `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed (2.665 should round to 2.66) and broke the nightly build.

This PR switches the quantize call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch. CI passed, and PR #101 against main is open with alex requested as reviewer.

- **Cause:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, though its own docstring says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212). So 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66, and `test_half_even` failed.
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/money-banker-rounding`, I changed the import and the rounding call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. That's the only change, in commit 08d3cd5986.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on that commit.
- **PR:** #101 (https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101). The first attempt to open it was rate-limited, so I retried with the same request ID, which means only one PR was created.

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system doesn't recognise that ID. The fix just follows the docstring and the test. I haven't merged the PR; that still needs code-owner approval.
